elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Stop losing your whole evening to one app.

[confident] Here's the fix. Give the app a daily timer.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Digital Wellbeing. Tap Dashboard and pick the app. Tap the hourglass and set a limit.

[delighted] When time's up, the app grays out until midnight.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
coverLine: Give your worst app a timer
